Liiga shotmap

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_shotmap.Rd

One game's shots with rink-image coordinates (pixels), shooter, blocker and skaters on ice; from 2016.

Usage

liiga_shotmap(season, game_id)

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025-26). Game ids repeat across seasons, so a game is (season, game_id).

game_id

Game id (game_id in liiga_schedule or liiga_games), e.g. 1; unique only within a season.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (15 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
game_idintegerGame id, unique only within a season: key a game as (season, game_id).
typecharacterStrength of the shot, e.g. EvenStrengthShot, PowerplayShot.
shooting_team_idintegerTeam id of the shooter's team (the number of the <num>:<slug> key).
left_team_idintegerTeam whose shots are drawn at the right end of the rink image (x grows toward it).
right_team_idintegerTeam whose shots are drawn at the left end of the rink image.
game_timeintegerSeconds from the start of the game. Regular season: 3900 (65:00) = the end of the 5-minute overtime; playoff overtime runs past it.
periodintegerPeriod number: 1-3 are regulation, 4 and up overtime (or the shootout).
shot_xintegerShot x on the site's rink drawing. Game 1 of 2026: x 90-932; the leftTeam's shots lie at x 188-932 and the rightTeam's at 90-379, so x grows toward the right end. Origin, unit and image width are not stated (unverified).
shot_yintegerShot y on the site's rink drawing. Game 1 of 2026: y 9-514. Origin, direction and image height are not stated (unverified).
blocker_idintegerPlayer id of the goalkeeper or skater who stopped the shot, else null.
shooter_idintegerShooter's player id.
event_typecharacterShot outcome: GOAL, GOALIE_BLOCKED (saved), MISSED, PLAYER_BLOCKED.
own_team_players_on_iceintegerShooting team's skaters on ice.
other_team_players_on_iceintegerDefending team's skaters on ice.

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/shotmap/{season}/{game_id}

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_teams_history(), liiga_tournament()
